results.title: COP31 host Turkey to push ‘age of electricity’, but will it be green?
results.description: COP31 host Turkey will urge countries on Tuesday to put a goal to increase the share of electricity in global energy use at the centre of the conference's final agreement, despite criticism the plan could do little to cut emissions.
